change.before: apply calls validate (which derives the result), then derives the same immutable result again
change.after: validate_and_derive returns that call's validated result for apply to reuse

profile.limit: Unminified diagnostic bundle, whole fixture including startup and untimed assertions, not isolated typing percentages or a controlled speed comparison.

verification.newRegression: repeated_application_rechecks_untouched_document_budget: success, untouched-sibling total-budget rejection, repeat success and exact inverse with the same operation
verification.clippy: cargo clippy --locked -p breditor-core --features experimental-structural-properties --lib --tests -- -D warnings: passed
verification.format: cargo fmt --all -- --check: passed after correcting the new test's let-else wrapping
verification.initialTargetedRun: 14 selected replacement tests passed; remaining zero-test integration executable launches were intentionally stopped. The subsequent complete library run includes the new regression. This is not a full integration-suite pass.
verification.rawWasm: Node list commands/recovery and heading compatibility passed; five runs each Chromium 151.0.7922.34, Firefox 153.0 and WebKit 26.5 passed

dom.scope: List router, controllers, queue, toolbar, selection, exact history and V6 recovery; synthetic clipboard/composition; native IndexedDB/SHA-256 autosave; high-level startup/rollback and backup recovery. Not physical OS clipboard or IME.

verification.packedConsumers: Three browser engines passed; base Node import, strict types and Chromium smoke passed against the same private installed artifacts

productionTiming.method: Sequential A/B/A runs, identical minified fixture and browser JS tarball, old/new/old experimental Wasm, three independent owners per size, no profiling or compilation overlap
productionTiming.conclusion: All 81 measured correctness cases passed. Variation is too large to claim a reliable end-to-end speedup; large-list latency remains an open gate. The deterministic reduction is one fewer derivation per apply.

profilingFollowup.failure: One Chromium profiling-mode run timed out at the unchanged 180-second completion wait with no console/page errors. Partial CPU profile saved. Cause not established.
profilingFollowup.recheck: Passed all nine cases and warm-up. Fixture/assertions/timeout unchanged; runner now captures fixture DOM status/output on failure. Unminified JS bundles differ only in a source-region comment containing the unique temporary fixture path. The passing recheck does not explain the timeout.
